limitations_and_decision: Preparation passes for one separately ROOT-admitted bounded diagnostic. This review does not dispatch or authorize production replacement.
CPU proof did not exercise CUDA profiler activity metadata or real learned49-gradient/Adam comparisons. The pending run must actually pass them.
Two unprofiled calls per arm provide a small balanced diagnostic, not reliable steady-state throughput or a full-parent result.
Classifier-logit copies and CPU gradient capture add equal diagnostic overhead; learned/complete clocks must retain their disclosed scope.
Trace file byte limits do not cap Kineto in-memory event storage directly; the full-recording prefix and existing32GiB host guardian bound the experiment.
Initial first-sweep recomputation, representative-gradient scatter and moved direct-up addition need strict CUDA checks; CPU exactness does not establish them.
Architecture adoption still requires independent-parent predictive evaluation with zero margins and sealed TEST; this prefix test cannot satisfy that gate.
